messages.content: 在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？

function.name: play_poker

message.content:
在大多數標準的撲克遊戲（例如德州撲克、奧馬哈等）中，每位玩家都會被發到相同數量的手牌（德州撲克是兩張，奧馬哈是四張）。因此，沒有任何一個玩家會比其他人手中持有更多的紙牌。  

如果你把「發牌者」視為「發牌員」，那麼他並不會保留自己的手牌；他只是負責將牌發給每位玩家，並不會持有額外的紙牌。  

簡而言之：在正常的撲克遊戲裡，所有玩家手中的紙牌數量都是相等的，沒有誰會「擁有最多」的紙牌。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" They want to know who has the most cards in a poker game. In standard poker games like Texas Hold'em, each player gets two private cards (hole cards). But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more than others. But maybe they refer to the dealer? In Texas Hold'em, the dealer deals cards to each player, but each player receives the same number of cards. So no one has more. But maybe they refer to the dealer having the most cards? Actually, the dealer deals but doesn't hold them. In some variations like Omaha, each player gets four cards. But still equal. So answer: In standard poker, each player gets the same number of cards; no one has more. If you consider the dealer, they don't hold cards. So answer: No one has more. Or if you consider the dealer's role, they deal but not hold. So answer accordingly.
